page: Microsoft Azure E96_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by a dedicated 48-core, 96-thread Intel Xeon 8370C processor operating at 2.8 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Hardware features include 260 MB of shared L3 cache, 2 MB of L2 cache per core, and instruction set support for AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, SHA_NI, and VAES. System memory is sized at 672.0 GB, allocating 7.0 GB per virtual core. The server includes no bundled local storage and zero GPUs, requiring persistent data to reside on attached external storage volumes.

Benchmark data reflects strong parallel processing and high memory subsystem throughput alongside average single-core speeds. Multi-core performance metrics rank in the top 25%, highlighted by a PassMark CPU score of 76593.39, a Geekbench multi-core result of 17797.0, and a stress-ng multi-core score of 93248.4. Cryptographic execution ranks in the top 10% with a PassMark CPU encryption score of 86888.24. Memory bandwidth reaches 331.76 GB/sec for large uncached reads and 140.18 GB/sec for writes. Conversely, single-core benchmarks remain in the middle 50% tier, with Geekbench single-core at 1713.0 and stress-ng single-core at 1899.3, establishing that performance gains derive from parallel scaling rather than single-threaded clock speed.

The configuration provides high memory density and multi-core throughput, making it suitable for memory-intensive workloads that require substantial caching capacity. Strong benchmark results in Redis SET operations (87.1 million operations per second) and PassMark database operations (30848.73) indicate suitability for in-memory caching, large relational database management systems, data processing pipelines, and multi-threaded compilation tasks.
description: Microsoft Azure E96_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by an Intel Xeon 8370C processor with 96 vCPUs (48 physical cores) running at 2.8 GHz on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is equipped with 672.0 GB of RAM, a 260 MB L3 cache, and hardware support for AVX-512 and VAES acceleration. No local storage or discrete GPUs are integrated into the profile. The instance delivers top-quartile multi-threaded compute performance and high memory bandwidth, achieving 331.76 GB/sec for large uncached reads and 87.1 million Redis SET operations per second, while single-core processing scores sit within the median 50% range. Given its resource ratio of 7.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, the instance is structured for memory-heavy enterprise software, large transactional and analytical databases, in-memory caches, and concurrent multi-threaded workloads.
